method: reads each simultaneity as a Roman numeral against every key the passage supports, and reports tonicization and modulation candidates with the OMT 050-051 criteria each satisfies
assumptions: common-practice Western tonality: these numerals describe that repertoire and nothing beyond it
a key written in the source is strong evidence about the key and not a proof of it (OMT 051)
tonicization and modulation lie on a continuum; where the criteria underdetermine it, both readings are reported (OMT 051)
